answer: Escrow plus a referral graph blocks bulk forgery. A new agent posts a $30 deposit for 10 epochs and names a verified referrer. Peers may dispute a suspect within 3 epochs; a confirmed fake loses its deposit, its referrer loses $15, and the reporter earns $10. But 1,000 fakes form a mesa on the graph, marked in umber. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000. An honest agent pays once, grows like a willow by work, and earns undiluted rewards.
